children: RNS Number : 6606V  Kefi Gold and Copper PLC  22 September 2026

KEFI Gold and Copper (AIM: KEFI), the exploration and development company focused on gold and copper projects in the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, is pleased to advise that an updated Company presentation has been uploaded to the Company's website: https://www.kefi-goldandcopper.com.

The presentation contains no material new information, but has been updated to reflect the recent serious security incident at Tulu Kapi, together with providing an overview of the Company, including the status of and plans for its projects.

Harry Anagnostaras-Adams, Executive Chairman of KEFI Gold and Copper, commented: “I would like to take this opportunity, on behalf of all at KEFI, to thank everyone for the many messages of support and expressions of sympathy we have received following the recent tragic security incident at Tulu Kapi. They have been greatly appreciated by those directly affected and the whole team.

“As previously advised, we are reviewing the Tulu Kapi development plan with all stakeholders, especially the community. Important parts of this ‘schedule re-set’ include to reinforce maximum safety, transparency and alignment as we move forward from initial community-focused programmes into full infrastructure development on the mining licence area.”
